press_references.value: Mountain View to Host June’s Creative Industry Summit at Heartwork

partnership_announcements.description: Mountain View and Creative Industry Summit entered a strategic partnership to host the 28th Creative Industry Summit at Heartwork in iCity New Cairo in June 2026, aiming to support Egypt’s creative economy through a dedicated space for networking and innovation.

press_references.value: EGP 25 Billion Construction Budget for 2026: Mountain View Sets One of the Largest Investment Benchmarks in Egypt’s Real Estate History

partnership_announcements.description: Mountain View announced multiple new strategic partnerships to support its 2026 construction program and projects, including Arabtec and CCC for EGP 5 billion worth of works, Crystal Lagoons for a large man-made lagoon in the North Coast, AHK Egypt and Nahdet Misr for workforce training, and e& for digital infrastructure across its communities.

press_references.value: Mountain View signs strategic partnership with Core Livings as its official partner for rental and resale services across all flagship projects

partnership_announcements.description: Mountain View has signed a strategic partnership with Core Livings, making Core Livings the official and exclusive digital partner for resale services across all Mountain View projects and for rental services in the Mountain View Ras El Hekma project. The partnership aims to deliver a seamless, tech-driven rental and resale experience and expand digital services across Mountain View's communities.

press_references.value: Mountain View achieves EGP 10bln in sales within just 48 hours of launching Grand Valleys at Kayan City

partnership_announcements.description: Mountain View and STM Investment announced a strategic partnership to develop the Grand Valleys project at Kayan City, aiming to deliver high-quality integrated residential communities in East Cairo.

press_references.value: Mountain View and STM Investment collaborate to develop a premium residential community with global standards in Kayan City

partnership_announcements.description: Mountain View and STM Investment have announced a partnership to develop a premium residential community in Kayan City, East Cairo. The project will span 500 feddans and include over 1,200 villas, marking a strategic expansion for Mountain View.

about_short_description.short_description: Mountain View is a real estate investment and management firm that offers property development and investment services in the locality.

product.name: Residential and Resort Property Development
product.description: Development of residential and resort properties in prime locations across Egypt, including East and West Cairo, the Red Sea Coast, and the North Coast.

product.name: Community Living Projects
product.description: Creation of interconnected residential communities with amenities designed to foster social interaction and lifestyle experiences.

product.name: Mountain View Foundation Programs
product.description: Social development programs including talent support, vocational training, and technical education to support community growth and skills development.

product.name: Innovative Housing Concepts
product.description: Development of specialized housing products such as iVilla, Wood House, Lake House, and Greenhouse that integrate environmental and lifestyle features.

product.name: iCity Urban Development Concept
product.description: A multi-layered urban design concept featuring themed parks, car-free environments, and integrated pedestrian and vehicle access.

product.name: The Lighthouse Community Center
product.description: A community center offering workshops, programs, and events to support personal development and social engagement within Mountain View communities.
